nodes.n: Before you can decide, Vivaan releases Part Three. Not a document. A voice note.
Your voice. Suite 1104. "Married in public, strangers in private. Got it." Someone recorded the first meeting.

nodes.th: Only three people were in that room. Me. Tara. Nikhil.

nodes.t: ...Yes. I record every meeting. It's insurance. Sushma bought my archive for forty lakh. I didn't think she'd give it to HIM.

choice.t: "You'll fix this. Or I'll tell the press who sold it."

nodes.n: Board headquarters. The president, two sponsors on speakerphone, and a lawyer drinking a lot of water.
"Captain. You deceived the public. Resign the captaincy, or we remove you on Monday."

nodes.t: If he goes, I go. And so do nine others. We've signed a letter. It's very badly spelled, but we signed it.

msgs.t: Puttar. I'm watching TV. They are calling you a liar.
You were a liar. For a few weeks. Then you weren't.
Go and tell them when it stopped. That part is true.

nodes.cliff: Monday, you lose the captaincy. Unless you say something on Sunday that nobody expects.
